comment: He is a great professor. Super accessible, flexible, and gives great feedback and guidelines so you know exactly what he is looking for. He truly cares about his students. Even though there is a lot of reading in the beginning, if you are on top of it and complete the assignments with decent effort, you can easily do well in the class.

absolute goat, i love him so much. he is so caring and sweet it feels like hes a highschool teacher. his class feels like a sanctuary compared to the rest. u have to read a lot, but as long as u do ur best on the writing and u participate in class often u will get a certain A
